AutoAttack.subject: A bronze clenched fist encircled by two broad rotating amber motion arcs, suggesting repeated automatic close-range punches. Compact central silhouette.

Buff.subject: A central dark torso igniting a split gold-and-violet adjustable aura, three broad facets radiating around its chest. Personal customizable power, no sliders or text.

Focus.subject: One calm pair of closed eyes inside a bright indigo forehead-shaped halo, energy drawn inward into a single small white point. Symmetric concentration.

BuffMuscleForce.subject: A massive flexed forearm with a hard amber stone-like aura bracing the elbow. Earthy ochre, warm white highlights; emphasize muscle and solidity.

BuffCombatMathematics.subject: A silver stylized eye with three geometric trajectory lines converging onto a tiny red opponent silhouette, cool teal calculated precision. No equations or numbers.

BuffKiBlade.subject: A short violet luminous energy edge hugging a forearm held diagonally, a broad tight crescent of energy along its side. Compact martial stance emblem.

BuffMagicForce.subject: A purple human chest silhouette with three bright broad currents circulating around it like a magical turbine. Plum, lilac-white; no written runes.

BuffOffensiveStance.subject: A side-on red fighter silhouette with forward fist extended and back heel raised, large sharp orange spearhead aura pointing forward.

BuffDefensiveStance.subject: A dark fighter torso behind two crossed forearms, layered broad steel-blue chevrons protecting the body. Compact triangular braced stance.

BuffBleedingEdge.subject: A crimson blade-like speed streak crossing a silver sprinting silhouette, two sharp dark-red accents trailing it. Dangerous mobility stance, no gore.

BuffBurningFist.subject: One tight orange fist surrounded by a single flaring red flame plume angled forward. The flame hugs the knuckles, compact aggression.

BuffKiFist.subject: A palm-sized white-violet fist with three circular force rings converging around the knuckles. Bright purple controlled focused unarmed force.

BuffDemonicFury.subject: A snarling dark horned demonic mask silhouette within a heavy crimson aura with two broad upward flame horns. Purple shadow, red-white highlights.

BuffAngelicGrace.subject: Two ivory feather-like wing sweeps cradle a small poised airborne silhouette. Pale gold and sky blue graceful mobility; no religious symbols.

BuffChannel.subject: A planted mage silhouette with open arms drawing two enormous violet streams inward to the chest; broad vertical pillar of power, stillness at center.

UltimateHighTension.subject: A muscular bronze torso splitting a large dark restraint ring with an explosive gold aura. Huge broad white-gold spikes convey peak power.

UltimateGodspeed.subject: A white airborne silhouette cutting through a sharp zigzag of electric blue lightning, with a single long lightning wing trail; stronger vertical zigzag than a normal dash.

UltimateFistsOfFury.subject: Two oversized red-hot fists punching outward from one central orange explosion, strong symmetric V-shaped arrangement; relentless strength.

UltimateArcanePower.subject: A large amethyst radiant orb suspended between three broad nested magical arcs, intense violet-white center and deep purple space.

UltimateBestialWrath.subject: A roaring broad jade-green beast maw with three amber claws sweeping beneath it, all one compact aggressive aura emblem.

UltimateBushido.subject: One immaculate ivory katana held upright before a red rising sun circle, two small dark shoulders at the base. Balanced sober gold and crimson discipline.

HokutoShinken.subject: A wall of many compact cyan fists rushing toward the viewer, one large focal fist at front with a fan of five clear afterimage fists behind. Rapid barrage, no wolf.

KiFist.subject: Two bare knuckles sheathed in solid luminous cyan gauntlets of energy, fists facing each other. Thick glowing cuffs and blue-white aura.

KiSword.subject: A single straight translucent turquoise sword made entirely of ki, fine light blade and luminous hilt, angled upward with a compact energy spark at tip.

KiHammer.subject: A single gigantic square-headed cobalt energy hammer, oversized translucent head, short handle, blazing cyan edges, diagonal heavy silhouette.

SpiritSword.subject: A tall elegant emerald-white blade with a long spirit-flame tip and bright floating oval energy core at its hilt. Clean vertical graceful supreme ki weapon.

Block.subject: Two dark braced forearms crossed into a large X stopping one blunt amber impact burst, thick blue-white protective rim, crop near elbows.

ViltrumiteGuard.subject: A muscular dark upper body in tight boxing guard stopping a frontal white impact with one braced forearm. Crimson rim light and a small gold opening behind the stopped impact.

GuardBreak.subject: One red fist cracking a large angular blue guard plate into three pieces. The wide fractured opening is the main readable symbol.

CriticalEdge.subject: A sharply tilted silver sword edge reflecting a tiny crimson four-point critical glint, close-up razor edge and black negative space. Weapon stance, not a full sweep.

Slice.subject: A slim silver sword cutting one clean short diagonal ivory slash against navy black. Simple fast stroke, no extra effects.

Bash.subject: The large blunt brass pommel of a sword striking a violet-white four-lobed stun burst. Pommel dominates, no blade edge impact.

Flourish.subject: A curved silver sword spinning through two elegant gold ribbon arcs in a circular flourish. Clearly ornamental movement, bold broad arcs.

WindHowl.subject: A silver curved cutting shockwave expanding as three broad circular wind crescents, blue-white gusts on dark slate, no wolf.

IaiSlash.subject: A black scabbard in the lower corner and a katana being drawn across a long horizontal icy-white slice; a single faint advancing silhouette behind.

Riposte.subject: Two blades crossing, a dark incoming blade halted by a bright blue parrying blade that curls into one gold returning arc. Strong X and return motion.

Cleave.subject: A heavy steel blade sweeping a very wide orange semicircle across three simple dark target silhouettes. Broad frontal fan silhouette.

SwordStab.subject: A long silver blade foreshortened directly toward the viewer, point dominant, two aligned dark silhouettes behind its straight narrow path. Crimson glint.

OverheadSmash.subject: A heavy weapon head descending vertically with a thick amber trail and three blocky chips flying from a linear impact below.

ColossalImpact.subject: An enormous dark hammer striking a central point with two broad expanding golden shock rings and large angular fragments, radial mass.

BurningSlash.subject: Three curved red-orange slash arcs stacked into a claw-like fan, a silver blade finishing the longest final streak; subtle dark crimson tear, no gore.

Headbutt.subject: Two simplified head silhouettes in side profile colliding forehead-first, the attacking forehead large with a compact bronze-white impact star.

UppercutCombo.subject: A large clenched fist rising vertically on a corkscrew orange trail, three broad ascending impact accents and a small launched silhouette above.

AxeKick.subject: A bent leg with the heel driving straight down like an axe, broad pale gold vertical crescent following the downward foot. No weapon.

KickbackCombo.subject: One strong forward kick at center, a faint advancing afterimage beyond it, and a second compact fist burst at far edge. Two separated orange impacts linked by cyan motion.

MarchOfFury.subject: An advancing red fighter with four large staggered fist echoes forming a stepping diagonal toward the viewer. Heavy marching momentum.

PileDriver.subject: Two compact faceless wrestling silhouettes, the attacker holding an inverted opponent as both plunge toward a single orange ground impact. Non-graphic, bold readable grapple pose.

MegatonThrow.subject: One fighter lifting an opponent through a broad golden overhead arc then throwing them outward, simplified two figures, powerful diagonal airborne throw.

ConsecutiveNormalPunches.subject: A large neutral bare fist in the middle of six broad orange fist afterimages lined up horizontally. Restrained warm white and russet, rapid repeated straight punches.

ExplodingHeartStrike.subject: Two rigid fingertips touching a dark torso silhouette, one small precise crimson inner burst glowing beneath the chest. Non-graphic internal pressure strike.

TexasSmash.subject: An immense forward fist smashing through one huge squared golden blast of pressure, foreshortened knuckles dominate, massive short raw impact.

WingClip.subject: A low horizontal sweeping boot tracing a wide teal semicircle across two small lower-leg silhouettes. Ankle-level sweep, no wings.

SandThrow.subject: A large open palm flinging one ochre sand fan toward a half-closed dark eye silhouette. Broad sandy crescent, only a few large grit accents.

BurningShot.subject: A flaming fist emerging from a short violet warp streak, three orange-white impact lobes clustered around the knuckles. Fire plus close-range combo.

BlueCometSpecial.subject: A small compact fighter at the head of a thick blue comet, five broad white motion bands converging into a forward elbow. Long diagonal accelerating rush.

CometReversal.subject: A bright cyan beam bends back along one broad U-shaped arc around a braced dark fighter, with a small white fist impact at the returning tip. Countering a beam then attacking.

ViltrumiteRush.subject: A broad-shouldered crimson-and-white flying fighter driving shoulder-first through a broken dark guard, thick straight red speed trail, imperial violent momentum.

RibBreaker.subject: A compact bare fist striking the side of a dark torso, three stylized ivory rib arcs visible as an abstract impact overlay, amber compression burst, no gore.

RelentlessPursuit.subject: Two airborne silhouettes in a long straight chase, the larger crimson pursuer connected to the small pale target by one sharp gold pursuit trail. No impact explosion.

ConquerorsGrip.subject: One large pale hand clamping tightly around a dark opponent's shoulder and upper arm, crimson angular pressure aura. Strong C-shaped grip.

MeteorDrop.subject: Two locked grapple silhouettes falling vertically like a dense red meteor into a broad golden ground crater. Pair remains compact, no gore.

SpearHand.subject: An outstretched knife-hand with fingers tightly together thrusting diagonally like an ivory spear, sharp red edge and compact crimson pressure tear. No literal spear, no gore.

NolansCombination.subject: A muscular crimson fighter delivers a chain of three blunt pale fist echoes ending in one long ivory knife-hand slash. Four clearly rhythmic marks, compact diagonal composition.

PunishingReversal.subject: A sharply bent elbow pivots back against a stopped dark incoming fist, one tight red hooked counter arc and gold impact glint. Elbow is the unmistakable main shape.

WallOfFlame.subject: Five tall broad orange flame pillars joined into one continuous horizontal wall, dark bases and white-hot crest, no scenery.

DragonNova.subject: A huge deep blue charged sphere with a dragon-shaped cyan energy ribbon curled around its lower edge. Weighty round mass, strong glowing core.

SkyBreak.subject: A large sword swinging upward and launching one enormous blue-white triangular pressure wave that splits two dark cloud shapes. Clear rising sonic blast.

EchoingSlash.subject: Three clean parallel ivory crescent cutting waves traveling away from a short silver blade, diminishing in size, teal motion accents, no explosion.

SuperGhostKamikaze.subject: Three mischievous pale violet ghost copies with broad pointed hair and curled smoky tails, one leading ghost large and two smaller behind. Simple eyes and mouths, no named character faces.

DefensiveBlasting.subject: A faceless fighter leaping backward to the left while a broad fan of orange ki pellets pursues forward to the right. Opposing motion directions are clear.

SphereOfDestruction.subject: A small intensely black-violet orb with a thick magenta rim tracking a faint distant silhouette along one curved red path. Orb fills most of frame, controlled compact menace.

AuraOfDestruction.subject: A dark standing silhouette engulfed by a wide purple destructive aura with thick outward hooked lobes, two tiny fading incoming motion streaks stopped at its edge.

DeathLaser.subject: A razor-thin ruby laser slicing horizontally through three aligned dark target silhouettes, bright red single straight line and one precise emitter glint. No charge orb.

Shockwave.subject: A low central fist releasing two broad amber and pale blue pressure rings outward, compact circular ripple silhouette.

SuperExplosiveWave.subject: A dark figure at the center of an enormous orange-white radial blast, two incoming blue energy balls shattering at its perimeter, bright outward force.

Earthquake.subject: An overhead circle of chunky stone slabs collapsing inward into a dark center, three thick amber cracks converge inward. Inward sinkhole force, no floating island.

GenkiDama.subject: One enormous luminous sky-blue sphere floating above two small upraised hands, three broad white energy currents gathering into its surface. Monumental round accumulated energy.

DeathBall.subject: One finger supporting a dense violet-black sphere with a red-white rim, three short jagged purple rays, compact fast hostile energy ball.

Supernova.subject: An enormous orange sunlike sphere with broad white cracks of power across its surface and one swelling red rim. Slow heavy massive explosion potential.

Kikoho.subject: Two stylized hands form a triangle aperture around a brilliant yellow-white triangular pressure blast. Strong triangular negative space, no letters.

LaserBeam.subject: A mechanical steel palm emitter fires a narrow straight lime-green energy beam, dark metal wrist and one concentric targeting ring.
LaserBeam.description: Cybernetic sustained energy laser projected from an artificial emitter.

Beam.subject: A single steady cyan-white energy wave emerging from one open palm, broad smooth stream with a rounded head.
Beam.description: Sustain concentrated ki as a controllable energy wave; the basis of named beam techniques.

Ray.subject: One extended finger fires a fine rose-red beam with one bright needle tip. Huge simple pointing hand silhouette, narrow attack.
Ray.description: A quick narrow Death Beam projected in a straight line.

Piercer.subject: Two fingertips launch a golden needle beam wrapped in a very tight violet spiral coil, spear point and tiny dark shield crack. Narrow precision, unlike the wide purple Double Sunday.
Piercer.description: A peak piercing beam that grows over distance and deals 2.3x damage to shields.

Kamehameha.subject: Two strongly cupped hands at lower left release a dense brilliant blue-white wave with a large rounded leading head. Wide familiar charged palm blast, crisp blue bands.
Kamehameha.description: A charged sustained martial-arts energy wave released from cupped hands.

Dodompa.subject: One upright pointing index finger emits a tiny gold star and a perfectly straight yellow-orange beam. Dominant hand with needle-thin gold line.
Dodompa.description: A focused narrow energy ray released from a single fingertip.

FinalFlash.subject: Two open palms side by side project a huge broad rectangular golden-white wave with diverging yellow shoulders. Maximum overwhelming width and raw luminous impact.
FinalFlash.description: The Beam tree's peak raw-power wave, built for maximum direct damage.

GarlicGun.subject: Two overlapping braced palms launch a thick violet wave with a white core and angular flared leading crest, deep magenta bloom, no corkscrew.
GarlicGun.description: A charged named sustained purple energy wave.

Masenko.subject: Two open palms stacked overhead, elbows suggested only as dark corners, release a compact angular golden beam forward from the high focal point.
Masenko.description: A named energy wave projected from an overhead palm stance.

BusterBarrage.subject: A dark central torso firing six thick orange energy bullets outward in irregular radial directions. Starburst volley silhouette.

AttackBarrier.subject: A dark figure inside a ring of six large blue ki orbs, nearest two orbs bright and ready to intercept a small orange approaching shot. Beaded sphere perimeter, not smooth shield.

Blast.subject: One small bright cyan ki projectile racing forward with a short simple white teardrop tail. Basic compact projectile; no hands.

BigBangAttack.subject: A broad open palm behind one compact brilliant teal-white energy ball, heavy dark blue outer rim and flared shock collar. Strong hand plus sphere silhouette.

Charge.subject: A dense blue sphere being compressed between two dark inward-curving palms, three thick white charge streaks pulled toward center. Ready-to-release explosive projectile.

CyberCharge.subject: A metallic forearm cannon with a broad glowing yellow capacitor orb at the muzzle, two angular amber charging plates. Mechanical concentrated shot.

Kienzan.subject: A razor-thin golden energy disc viewed at a shallow angle, large luminous ellipse with one sharp white cutting rim and short curved tail. No central handle.

SpinBlast.subject: Four bright cyan pellets rotate out of a broad spiral whirlpool, clear pinwheel motion with white-hot center. Circular continuous spray.

Makosen.subject: Two large parallel yellow-white energy clusters bursting into a dense short cone of smaller orange projectiles. Wide doubled barrage shape, not a beam.

TimeFreeze.subject: A large violet cosmic circle enclosing a frozen pale humanoid and three suspended amber fragments, a broad still silver hourglass silhouette behind. No clock numerals.

Explosion.subject: A bright red-orange burst erupting upward from one cracked ground point, large angular blast petals and a dark ring beneath.

ScatterShot.subject: Six magenta-white homing orbs suspended around one dark central target, curved trails all converging inward. Encirclement closing from all sides.

Sokidan.subject: One golden-white floating energy sphere making a sharp right-angle turn along a broad curved amber trail, a guiding hand at one lower corner.

Genocide.subject: A small dark planet silhouette with three long violet homing projectile trails arcing around its circumference toward one bright target point. No people or gore.

PhotonFlash.subject: A long narrow pale cyan beam with a clean diamond-shaped leading flare and two delicate broad parallel speed wings. Sleek efficient reach; no spiral.

BusterCannon.subject: A huge blunt orange-white cylindrical energy wave with a heavy red circular muzzle flare and thick short trail. Slow cannon-like mass; no physical cannon.

RockSlide.subject: A broad diagonal fan of five chunky amber stones moving in parallel, one leading mid-sized rock and four smaller but clear companions, ochre dust.

RockTomb.subject: One colossal almost-square dark boulder with bright amber fracture seams about to burst, two big slabs peeling outward. Much heavier than Rock Throw.

GiantForm.subject: Two overlapping dark humanoid silhouettes, a small one at base and an enormous broad-shouldered amber giant rising behind. Thick upward golden expansion arcs.

LimitBreaker.subject: A red muscular silhouette bursting through a broken gold limiter ring, one white-hot vertical crack in the aura and three heavy fragments; unstable peak power.

HideEnergy.subject: A small dim teal flame enclosed by two dark cupped hands inside a black shroud, only a thin violet rim betrays its presence. Concealed ki.

DashAttack.subject: A single red fist leading a stretched forward fighter silhouette through one long straight white-gold impact streak, force grows with distance.

DemonContract.subject: A dark parchment scroll curling around a glowing violet soul flame held by a claw-like crimson hand; parchment entirely blank, no letters or sigils.

SoulWeapon.subject: A ghostly magenta sword forming from a bright white soul flame in an open hand, diffuse violet edge and flowing spirit hilt.

SoulAttack.subject: A pale humanoid soul silhouette enclosed inside a fast deep red energy projectile, broad white trailing flame, one compact attack shape.

MeditateLevel2.subject: A calm seated lotus silhouette with three broad ascending purple aura rings and a bright golden flame at its core. Training through deep meditation.

Sense.subject: A luminous turquoise eye suspended above one broad curved planet horizon, two expanding pale blue awareness rings. Basic global sensing.

AdvancedSense.subject: One large cyan eye focused on a small glowing humanoid silhouette inside its iris, two clean contour rings around the figure. Personal energy inspection.

Sense3.subject: A silver-teal eye with a sharply detailed three-layer iris revealing a bright humanoid core and three small distinct energy facets. Advanced perception, no numerals.

ShadowSpar.subject: Two mirrored faceless fighters exchanging one clear punch, the real fighter warm bronze and the imaginary opponent translucent violet. Broad central sparring silhouettes.

Regeneration.subject: A cracked green forearm silhouette knitting back together under two emerald-white flowing bands, healed seam glows softly, non-graphic.

GivePower.subject: Two hands at opposite corners joined by a thick golden energy stream, the receiver's hand surrounded by a swelling orange aura. Energy transfer over distance.

KeepBody.subject: A closed silver martial guardian helmet and broad armored shoulder plates float inside a luminous golden protective halo, with a blue spectral echo of the same armor behind. Armor-only magical preservation emblem, no exposed body or skin. Large bold shapes.

MakeFruit.subject: One large luminous amber pear-like power fruit growing above an open hand, two broad green leaves and a concentrated orange inner glow.

Bind.subject: Two heavy crimson spectral shackles closing around a small dark spirit silhouette, one broad glowing chain arc descending into a dark red void. No gore.

Absorb.subject: One large pink elastic palm enveloping a smaller pale energy silhouette and drawing its glow inward, broad spiral red trail. Abstract absorption, no gore.

ShunkanIdo.subject: Two fingers touching a faceless forehead, a pale blue figure reappearing in a separate bright vertical sliver behind. Instant Transmission precision, blue and white.
ShunkanIdo.description: Instant Transmission follows a known person's energy and teleports the user and nearby companions.

Teleport.subject: Two small planet spheres connected by one broad violet-white space-fold arc, a compact dark traveler crossing at center. Interplanetary teleport.

PowerControl.subject: A calm dark upper torso between a rising gold aura on one side and a compressed blue aura on the other, one bright controlled core at chest.
PowerControl.description: Regulate ki output to power up, power down and control transformations.

Fly.subject: A pale airborne fighter rising diagonally with open space around their bent legs and two broad sky-blue lift streams below, no wings.

SelfDestruct.subject: A small dark humanoid silhouette dissolving at the center of a massive red-white spherical shockburst, broad jagged outward rays. Abstract non-graphic self-sacrifice.

KaioRevive.subject: One luminous upright golden soul emerging from a dim gray prone silhouette, a large soft white rising arc conveys return to life. No grave or cross.

UnlockPotential.subject: An open palm above a faceless forehead releases a hidden brilliant golden inner flame, dark outer shell separates into three broad pieces.

Imitation.subject: Two identical ivory face masks overlapping, one teal and one violet edge, a fluid light ribbon connects them. Identity mimicry, no real face.

Invisibility.subject: A nearly vanished humanoid torso outlined by a thin icy rim with its middle blending into the black background, one broad fading translucent sweep.

Observe.subject: A large violet eye gazing into a small distant scene framed by a luminous circle, a single pale humanoid silhouette within. Remote observation, no busy scenery.

Materialization.subject: An open violet-lit palm materializes a small copper sword and folded dark weighted robe from three broad golden energy fragments. Conjuring equipment.

Mystic.subject: A serene dark head and shoulders with a luminous white flame rising from the crown, lavender aura compressed tightly around the body, restrained awakened potential.
Mystic.description: A powerful mystic empowerment of the character.

FireFist.subject: A bare forearm with a large blazing fist, broad red-orange flames flow backward from the knuckles, concentrated white heat inside.
FireFist.description: A combat buff with a fiery fist aura.

SaiyanPower.subject: A jagged rising golden hair-like flame over a clenched dark fist, strong gold-white warrior power aura, no letters or emblems.

Majin.subject: A dark angular demonic forehead mask with two red glowing eyes and a violet flame crown, no letter on the forehead. Angry power, ominous crimson aura.

RestoreYouth.subject: A gray aged hand transforms along one bright green ribbon into a smooth youthful hand, split before-and-after contour without realistic wrinkles.

SplitForm.subject: One centered pale blue fighter splitting into two matching translucent fighters at the sides, a broad Y-shaped ribbon of ki connects them.

FinalExplosion.subject: A muscular standing silhouette with outstretched arms inside an expanding golden-white sphere, thick magenta charge rim and massive downward flare. Distinct golden sacrifice explosion.

Hakai.subject: A dark hand releases a tiny purple-white erasure core toward an abstract gray silhouette turning into violet dust fragments. Sparse stark void, non-graphic.

PressurePunch.subject: One enormous pale fist drives a compressed white pressure ring toward the viewer, thick amber concentric wake behind the knuckles, no fire.

RoundhouseKick.subject: A large sideways kicking leg sweeps a blue-white circular pressure crescent across the frame, hip rotation readable in a small dark torso behind. No fist.
RoundhouseKick.description: Rotate into a powerful sweeping kick that damages and knocks the opponent away. The legacy description incorrectly says punch; the implementation and VFX are a kick.

Dropkick.subject: Two extended boot soles lead a compact airborne fighter in a horizontal two-footed strike, broad orange-white impact burst at the feet.

Telepathy.subject: Two simple silver head silhouettes facing each other, a broad violet wave connects glowing points at their temples. Thought transmission, no speech text.
Telepathy.description: Send thoughts directly to another character.

MakeHolyPendant.subject: A single luminous gold protective pendant with an oval pale sapphire center and a short chain arc, bright white sheltering halo, no religious cross.

UltraSuperSaiyan.subject: An enormous muscular golden warrior torso with a jagged high golden hair silhouette, flaring amber aura, bulk and power dominate over motion.
UltraSuperSaiyan.description: A bulky Super Saiyan transformation that emphasizes muscular power.

ThirdEye.subject: A closed pair of eyes beneath one large open violet-white forehead eye, clear vertical diamond arrangement and soft golden awareness halo.

FocusinRevert.subject: A violet head silhouette with a small dark artificial crystal above the forehead being lifted away by a pale hand, one calming blue circular sweep.
FocusinRevert.description: Remove the effects of Focusin from oneself or another character.

MilestoneBleedingEdge.subject: A heavy silver sword edge with one suspended dark ruby droplet and a broad crimson stance crescent, black steel background, no wound.

MilestoneThunderingBlows.subject: A steel hammer head wrapped in one bold branching gold lightning fork, compact pale impact star beneath. Weapon shock and stagger.

MilestoneVenomousIntent.subject: A silver blade coated in bright emerald venom, one large green droplet at tip and a coiling dark serpent-like vapor ribbon.

MilestoneCrushingResolve.subject: A pale clenched fist crushing one violet crystal willpower flame, three large purple shards spilling downward, black crimson pressure aura.

Reincarnation.subject: A dim violet adult soul spirals into a small bright golden new humanoid silhouette, one large flowing circular cycle of light. Renewal without grave symbols.

NamekianFusion.subject: Two green faceless warrior silhouettes merging shoulder-to-shoulder into one luminous jade figure, broad gold convergence arcs. No named characters.

GreatApe.subject: A roaring enormous brown ape head with red eyes under a small pale full moon, broad golden aura, chunky fierce silhouette, no scenery.

HeranTransformation.subject: A faceless turquoise warrior torso with blazing swept orange hair and a broad jade-white power flare, strong additive energy surge.

GooTrap.subject: A large glossy pink pool with one elastic hand-shaped tendril reaching toward a small dark foot, purple shadow and bright pink rim, trapping motion.

BodySwap.subject: Two contrasting faceless torso silhouettes, one purple and one pale green, joined by two broad opposing curved spirit streams. Body exchange without gore.

Overdrive.subject: A dark mechanical heart reactor forced open with a red-hot center and three strained orange circuit veins. Cybernetic power beyond limits, no text.

ScrapAbsorb.subject: A mechanical open palm draws three large broken steel fragments into its glowing green core, heavy cobalt metal edges and green energy intake.

Fireball.subject: One blazing round orange sphere with a thick curling flame tail, white hot core and charred red rim. Distinct organic fire, no ki rings.

FrostBolt.subject: One long sharp icy blue crystal shard flying diagonally with three broad frozen wisps, white pointed ice edge and deep cobalt facets.

LightningBolt.subject: One massive jagged gold-white lightning bolt crosses the square, two bold side branches and a small violet charged halo at origin.

FrostNova.subject: A central pale blue ice crystal detonates into six large radial frost spikes, thick icy circular shockring, cold navy negative space.

EarthPrison.subject: Four chunky tall ochre rock slabs enclose a small dark central figure in a square ring, clear view from above at an angle, amber cracks, no landscape.

EmpoweredAttacks.subject: Three small bronze clenched fists share one large bright orange enchantment halo, the central fist largest, communal offensive empowerment.

EmpoweredDefenses.subject: Three simplified blue shield-like body outlines covered by one broad silver-teal protective arc, central figure larger. Ally-wide defense blessing.

Accelerate.subject: A stylized silver winged boot inside one broad green arc with three short gold speed ticks, lightweight magical haste, no numerals.

Rejuvenate.subject: A single open hand cradles a bright emerald-white growing life flame with two broad upward leaf-like energy petals, restorative magic distinct from paired Heal hands.

GravityWell.subject: A dark central sphere bends three thick concentric violet orbit rings downward into a deep funnel, two heavy gray stones pulled toward it.

CreatePortal.subject: One upright violet oval portal with a bright silver inner rim and a smaller matching portal reflected through its center, a pale foot crossing the threshold.

Enchant.subject: A hovering amethyst crystal sends three broad white-violet ribbons into a silver sword blade, the enchanted edge turns luminous gold. Equipment enchantment.

ArcaneCrafting.subject: Two broad violet hands shape a hovering rough amethyst crystal into a small gold arcane vessel, large fragments converge, ritual creation without runic text.

VampireBite.subject: A stylized open pale mouth with two long white fangs above one red life-energy droplet, dark plum background, non-graphic vampiric feeding.

GodFist.subject: One dark clenched fist inside an intense crimson flame aura, three broad rising red power bands flare from the wrist, white-hot red rim. Kaioken escalation.

Defend.subject: One plain bronze forearm braced vertically with the other fist held close behind, a small blue impact stopped in front. Fundamental guard.

FlashStep.subject: A white boot disappearing through one narrow turquoise flash seam, a single faint boot afterimage just behind. Instant short movement, no full figure.

Evade.subject: A crouched dark figure slipping sideways under one broad amber incoming attack streak, cool cyan afterimage curving down and away.

Injure.subject: A narrow gold strike glint aligned with the joint of a dark limb silhouette, three crimson pressure marks, restrained non-graphic targeted injury.

Grab.subject: A large bare bronze hand tightly gripping a dark wrist, C-shaped fingers and a small gold squeeze accent, straightforward close grapple.

ManualAttack.subject: One large bare bronze fist with a compact white four-point impact at its leading knuckles, plain single punch and minimal motion.

Lunge.subject: A forward bronze fighter silhouette leading with one fist and planted back foot, broad short amber triangular speed wedge. Committed melee entry.
Lunge.description: The universal committed melee approach used to enter close combat.

Train.subject: Two wrapped training fists held beside a small bronze striking post, one broad amber sweat-like energy arc. Physical training emblem.

Meditate.subject: A simple seated lotus silhouette with one soft teal circular aura and a white energy dot at chest, low calm composition.
Meditate.description: Meditation to recover health and energy.

PowerUp.subject: A dark clenched fist lifting through one broad ascending golden flame column, bright upward wedge of ki.
PowerUp.description: Raise controlled battle power by drawing out ki.

PowerDown.subject: Two lowered open dark palms settling a broad blue aura into one small calm white core, clear downward inward motion.
PowerDown.description: Lower battle power and settle the active ki aura.

MakeAmulet.subject: A dark silver amulet with a swirling violet-black void at its center, two broad curling purple suction trails on either side, ominous portal charm.

MakeDragonBalls.subject: A cluster of seven amber wish orbs, one large glowing orb at front and six smaller around it, stars as simple bright glints, no numerals or writing.

PlanetDestroy.subject: One dark blue planet cracking into three large pieces around a single blazing red-orange impact line, fragments remain legible, no people.
PlanetDestroy.description: A destructive energy technique aimed at breaking a planet.

Mate.subject: Two protective adult silhouettes curved around one tiny golden child-like energy figure, a broad soft rose and blue life ribbon joins the three. Family creation, symbolic and nonsexual.

ViltrumiteExecutionersHand.subject: One ivory knife-hand descending before a dark red crown-like power aura, a precise crimson cutting glint at its fingertips and a small cracked guard below. Passive lethal mastery, non-graphic.

MakeSwarm.description: Pestilence creates a replicating swarm with adjustable cohesion.
MakeSwarm.subject: Five dark bat-like gargoyle silhouettes coalesce into one swirling violet-green swarm, one large leading creature with two broad wings, sinister curved collective motion.

Transform.subject: A dark warrior silhouette shedding an outer blue shell to reveal a bright rising gold inner form, tall jagged aura and clear upward transformation.

RevertTransformation.subject: A tall golden aura collapsing gently into a smaller calm blue human silhouette, two broad downward light ribbons convey returning to base form.

RevertToLarvalForm.subject: A chunky green armored insect larva curled inside a broken pale shell, a broad descending violet energy ribbon indicates reverting into a compact biological form.
